$comment: Sentri RBAC matrix. Source of truth = `requireRole(...)` calls in backend/src/routes/*.js. Regenerate with: grep -rn 'requireRole(' backend/src/routes/. See QA.md > Permissions Matrix for the human-readable version. Hierarchy: admin > qa_lead > viewer.

GET /api/v1/runs/:runId/ai-requests.$comment: GAP-005 (migration 056) — per-run AI request log for the RunDetail Agent Call Timeline. Workspace ACL enforced inside aiRequestLogRepo.listByRun via the leading workspaceId = ? predicate; runId guesses for runs in another workspace return [] rather than 403.

GET /api/v1/workspaces/current/mfa-compl.$comment: SEC-004 — admin-only preview of how many workspace members have MFA enabled before flipping enforcement.

GET /api/v1/audit/verify.$comment: SEC-007 — walks the prevHash chain for the caller's workspace. No-op (chainDisabled:true) when AUDIT_HASH_CHAIN is unset.

GET /api/v1/system/security-events.$comment: SEC-007 — lists deployment-wide security events tagged with the SYSTEM_WORKSPACE_ID sentinel (chiefly auth.login.failed against unknown emails — credential-stuffing probes that fire before a tenant can be resolved). Cross-tenant by design; the workspace-scoped routes naturally exclude these rows. Defence-in-depth: rejects callers whose own workspaceId equals the sentinel.

GET /api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/audi.$comment: SEC-007 — workspace-scoped audit log with cursor pagination. The :workspaceId URL param is validated against req.workspaceId (the authenticated workspace) to prevent cross-workspace reads.
SEC-007 — lists SIEM dead-letter queue entries for the workspace. Same workspace-scope assertion as the audit-log route.

POST /api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/aud.$comment: SEC-007 — SIEM dead-letter replay. Re-dispatches the stored snapshot via dispatchSiemEvent. Returns 503 SIEM_NOT_CONFIGURED when no SIEM target is configured for the workspace.

GET /api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/siem.$comment: SEC-007 Part C — returns the masked SIEM forwarder config. hmacSecret is replaced with ••••••••<last4> so admins can confirm which secret is configured without exposing the value.

PUT /api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/siem.$comment: SEC-007 Part C — upsert SIEM config. hmacSecret encrypted at rest via credentialEncryption (AES-256-GCM). targetUrl validated by SSRF guard. headers JSON bounded at 4096 chars. Emits settings.update activity for audit trail.

DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/s.$comment: SEC-007 Part C — idempotent delete. Returns { ok: true, removed: false } when no config existed.

GET /api/v1/integrations/github/install/.noUi: Auth via signed one-shot state JWT, NOT requireAuth — SameSite=Strict cookies are not sent on cross-site redirects from github.com. The state JWT is issued by GET /install/start (admin-gated) so the callback inherits admin authority transitively.

POST /api/v1/projects/:id/trigger/github.noUi: machine-only GitHub PR webhook [no-ui] — dual-auth (Bearer trigger token via requireTrigger + X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC keyed by GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET)

POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/verify.$comment: SEC-004 — exchanges a single-use pendingToken (issued by /auth/login when MFA is required) plus a TOTP or recovery code for an auth cookie. CSRF-exempt + rate-limited (5/15min/IP) because the user has no cookie yet.

POST /api/v1/auth/webauthn/authenticate/.$comment: SEC-004 — returns WebAuthn assertion options. Peeks (does not consume) the pendingToken from /auth/login.
SEC-004 — verifies a WebAuthn assertion. Consumes the pendingToken, sets the auth cookie with amr=[pwd,mfa], and updates the credential's signature counter (clone detection).

POST /api/v1/settings/agent-roles/:role/.$comment: AI-005 — Settings UI "Test agent" button. Probes the configured (provider, role) pair via the same 1-token health-check helper the crawler pre-flight uses. Returns { role, ok, reason, provider }.

POST /api/v1/settings/provider-routes/:i.$comment: B3.6 — encrypts the new plaintext, runs a network probe against the candidate key BEFORE persisting, and rolls back to the prior ciphertext when the probe fails. Audit row emitted as action=rotate_key by the repo's diff path.

GET /api/v1/settings/provider-routes/exp.$comment: B3.5 — schema-v1 JSON dump of every provider_routes row in the workspace. Secrets are NEVER serialised (only apiKeyLastFour round-trips). Audit row appended as action=export with metadata={count, schemaVersion}.

POST /api/v1/settings/provider-routes/im.$comment: B3.5 — three-phase import: (1) upsert rows resolving name collisions per mode (skip|overwrite|rename), (2) rewire fallbackRouteId via source→destination id map, (3) bounded-parallel capability probe (IMPORT_PROBE_PARALLELISM=3). Audit row appended as action=import.

GET /api/v1/settings/provider-routes/aud.$comment: B3.9 — paginated workspace-scoped audit log viewer. Filterable by routeId / action / since / before. Cursor pagination via `before` matching the AI request log endpoint. Retention sweep is daily at 05:00 UTC, configurable via AI_ROUTES_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS (default 90).

outOfScope.$comment: Endpoints / flows present in code but not yet shipped end-to-end. Do NOT manually QA — file enhancement requests instead.

agentNotes: Abort run (POST /runs/:runId/abort) has no per-user 'own runs' restriction; any qa_lead can abort any run in their workspace.
Per-project notification settings (PATCH /projects/:id/notifications) are qa_lead-gated, NOT admin-only — different from global /settings.
Restore from recycle bin is qa_lead-gated; permanent purge is admin-only.
There is no in-app change-password endpoint; password reset does NOT invalidate other-device sessions.

SEC-004: MFA destructive actions (/auth/mfa/disable, /auth/mfa/recovery-codes/regenerate, DELETE /auth/webauthn/credentials/:id) require password confirmation in the request body. OAuth-only users (no passwordHash) authenticate by session — the password field is ignored. Removing the last passkey is blocked with 400 MFA_LAST_FACTOR_PROTECTED when any workspace the user belongs to enforces MFA past its grace window.
